spans.title: Escape in a Silk Gown
spans.blurb: Bailiffs search the house for a debt-dodging captain, who slips downstairs in his landlady's silk gown and veil. Staying free will take nerve, cheek, and one good punch.

spans.title: Ambush on the Platform
spans.blurb: A man waits alone for a shuttle train, one hand never leaving his coat pocket. Two strangers creep out of the woods behind him with a revolver.

spans.title: Chair Number Thirteen
spans.blurb: Aboard a night train, a traveler keeps glimpsing someone in chair thirteen, though the seat is plainly empty. Then a helpful voice speaks up behind her.

spans.title: The Toe in the Moonlight
spans.blurb: A traveler in a lockless room at a Dutch inn wakes at midnight to see a single bare human toe standing in a strip of moonlight.

books.pairNote: Two unrelated tales from the same collection, with different settings and payoffs.

spans.title: Adrift Below the Cliffs
spans.blurb: A stolen hour below the sea cliffs goes wrong: the lady cannot climb back, dusk is falling, fog is rolling in, and one small boat is their only chance.

spans.title: The Major and the Tiger
spans.blurb: Brought to bay, a tiger throws himself on his back, claws out, as hunters fire from their elephant. Then the twenty-two-stone major loses his balance.

spans.title: The Court Depressor
spans.blurb: Deep underground, a traveler and his dog meet a small solemn man whose hand glows clear as amber, and who sorrowfully bids them welcome to his land.

spans.title: The Thinking Machine's Wager
spans.blurb: A frail professor insists mind is master of all things, and wagers he can escape a prison death-cell within a week, asking only tooth powder, cash, and a shoeshine.

spans.title: The Boy in the Cherry Tree
spans.blurb: A princess who knows only her birds and butterflies chases a strange purple butterfly to the palace wall, where a laughing boy pelts her with ripe cherries.

spans.title: The Changed Prayer
spans.blurb: Through the long nights an enslaved woman prays for her master's heart to change, while he brings buyers to look at her. In March, her prayer changes.

spans.title: The Rescue of Charles Nalle
spans.blurb: Word races through Troy that a fugitive has been seized and will be sent south. One woman pushes through the crowd to the commissioner's door and stands her ground.

books.pairNote: Two separate true episodes from the same life, one inward and quiet, one a public street rescue.

spans.title: A Question of Symmetry
spans.blurb: Over breakfast, a fastidious little man lectures his friend on sea sickness, nervous ladies, and the moral failings of an asymmetrical piece of toast.

spans.title: The Road to Merlinville
spans.blurb: A detective and his friend cross to France in high spirits, trading banter about fox hunts and footprints, summoned by a millionaire's plea for protection.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the client is found murdered on arrival, the inciting shock at the end of the novel's opening chapters.

books.pairNote: The longer span alludes back to the breakfast conversation but shares no text with it, and their payoffs are entirely different.
